missingHashtags.title: Your post is missing the campaign's required hashtags!
missingHashtags.desc: The smart checker verified the video quality and that it is free of music, but it didn't find the contractual hashtags in the post caption. All you need to do is copy the hashtags below and paste them into the video caption in the TikTok app.

duplicateLink.title: This link has already been submitted in the system!
duplicateLink.desc: The smart checker matched the link and noticed it is already tied to a previous approved submission. The same video link can't be submitted twice to earn double profits for the same post. If you published a new clip for the campaign, please copy its unique link and paste it here.

linkGuide.title: How to copy the right link in 3 simple steps

open.title: Open the TikTok app
open.desc: Go to your profile and open the published Wafi ad clip.

share.title: Tap the Share button
share.desc: You'll find it at the bottom left of the video (the curved arrow icon).

copy.title: Choose "Copy Link"
copy.desc: Paste the link in the field above and tap "Re-check".

editGuide.title: Edit your post in one minute

open.title: Open the TikTok app
open.desc: Go to your profile and open this video.

share.title: Tap the three dots (⋯) then choose Edit post

copy.title: Paste the hashtags and save
copy.desc: Paste the copied hashtags into the caption, save the post, then tap "Re-check the post".

duplicateTips.title: How to make sure you copied a different clip's link?
duplicateTips.id: Check the last 13 digits of the TikTok link. This number is a unique ID for each separate clip.
duplicateTips.wait: If you just published the video, wait one minute until TikTok finishes processing it, then copy the direct link.
duplicateTips.noShort: Make sure you aren't using promotional shortened links.

previousSubmission.whyTitle: Why does the system block link reuse?
previousSubmission.whyDesc: Because the platform calculates earnings based on the unique views of each new clip published independently. A video that has already been rewarded can't be submitted again.
